scope: Actual offline full-head PaSST screen on 10 previously exposed owner clips: seven clear, one partial and two unclear. No application integration.

owner_contract.primary: Accepted manual lead included in actual final capped list.

candidate: Existing released PaSST OpenMIC20 full-head top two, including voice → Vocal; not the earlier 11-singleton row-replacement hybrid.
selection: Fixed native full-20-class stable-score top two; no annotation candidate restriction, threshold or outcome tuning.
decision: STOP this frozen full-head top-two policy: 4/7 ties both 4/7 controls; no net benefit. No tuning or expansion.

timed.status: Not run because owner gate failed; not zero accuracy.

exposure.interpretation: Exact publisher recording overlap; not independent confirmation. Manual lead labels differ from presence training labels, but audio exposure remains.

limits: Repeatedly exposed and publisher-overlapping development; no statistical generalization claim.
Four lead categories only; unsupported instruments and broad genre/audio-type coverage not tested.
No timed inference, full-track performance or multiwindow accuracy claim; no-clear/partial labels cannot establish full presence precision.
Weight rights remain conditional; no commercial or redistribution clearance asserted.
